title: Normalization of the whole compact-support tower
statement: Fix l,E,D,o and RealizationModel model as above. For every separated finite-type quasi-compact f between finite-type quasi-compact schemes over D.k, IsUnit(l:D.k), and compactification c, the exact tower T and finite evaluations e chosen by exists_compactSupportReductionTower admit a natural strict derived-tower comparison from reduction followed by o.shriek(c.i), o.push(c.g), and completed restriction on basicSupportDomain. Its finite evaluations are precisely supportEvaluation followed by reductionEvaluation. There is also a natural integral comparison to the recorded sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor. It equals model.push composed with the limit of model.openReduction, inverse actual open-output unit, and sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization, and satisfies every displayed scalar-adjoint finite projection equation in HasBasicRealizations. All-pairs transitions remain the prescribed compactSupportRestrictedTransition.

proof.text: Extract the exact chosen functor T and its evaluation family e from exists_compactSupportReductionTower, and retain its all-pairs transition equation. Apply the whole-input strict support-system comparison, and restrict that natural isomorphism along the basicSupportDomain inclusion. Its evaluated equation is unchanged by this whiskering.

Map IsUnit(l:D.k) to the global sections on X and c.Z. QuasiCompact(c.i) follows from QuasiCompact(f) by cancellation against the separated proper factor. Apply integralOpenMateNormalization on each basicSupportDomain input, using its input constructibility, good reduction and good intermediate open output. This gives invertibility of the actual open reduction mate and reconstruction unit. Their natural transformations restrict to natural isomorphisms. Apply total limit to the former and compose with the inverse of the latter to construct the open integral comparison.

Whisker model.push by the restricted open reduction, then compose with proper image of the preceding open integral comparison and with the prescribed sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization. This constructs d as an explicit natural isomorphism; unfolding its components gives exactly the required formula. For each finite projection, apply injectivity of the scalar-adjunction Hom equivalence. Its naturality moves the proper/open comparison outside the transpose. The specification of sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization rewrites the finite comparison into geometric coordinates. The projection transport lemma gives the remaining equation.

theorem integralSupportTowerNormalization (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    (o : Operations l E) (model : RealizationModel l E o) :
∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of D.k))] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (hl : IsUnit (l : D.k)) (c : Compactification f),
    ∃ (T : Integral l E X ⥤ coefficientSequenceRestrictedDerived l E Y)
      (e : ∀ n : ℕ,
        T ⋙ coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E Y n ≅ compactSupportRestrictedLevel l E c n),
      T = Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
        (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E D.k X Y f hl c))).2.2 ∧
      HEq e (Classical.choose (Classical.choose_spec
        (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec (Classical.choose_spec
          (exists_compactSupportReductionTower l E D.k X Y f hl c))).2.2).2).2) ∧
      (∀ (m n : ℕ) (h : n ≤ m)
        (K : (basicSupportDomain l E o c).FullSubcategory),
        (pbcTowerTransition Y (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y) m n h).app
            (T.obj K.obj) ≫ (e n).hom.app K.obj =
          (e m).hom.app K.obj ≫ compactSupportRestrictedTransition l E c m n h K.obj) ∧
      ∃ (tower : (basicSupportDomain l E o c).ι ⋙ (calculus l E X).reduction ⋙
          Operations.shriek l E o c.i ⋙ Operations.push l E o c.g ⋙
            coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction l E Y ≅ (basicSupportDomain l E o c).ι ⋙ T)
        (d : (basicSupportDomain l E o c).ι ⋙ (calculus l E X).reduction ⋙
          Operations.shriek l E o c.i ⋙ Operations.push l E o c.g ⋙
            coefficientSequenceLimit l E Y ≅
          basicSupportInput l E o c ⋙ sfCompactSupportFiniteIntegralFunctor l D.k hl c E ⋙
            (sfIntegralConstructible l E Y).ι),
        ∃ hunit : ∀ K : (basicSupportDomain l E o c).FullSubcategory,
          IsIso ((calculus l E c.Z).adjunction.unit.app ((ringedOpen l E c.i).obj K.obj)),
        (∀ K : (basicSupportDomain l E o c).FullSubcategory,
          d.hom.app K =
            (model.push l E c.g).hom.app
              ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K.obj)) ≫
            (ringedPush l E c.g).map
              ((coefficientSequenceLimit l E c.Z).map
                  ((model.openReduction l E c.i).app K.obj) ≫
                @inv _ _ _ _ ((calculus l E c.Z).adjunction.unit.app
                  ((ringedOpen l E c.i).obj K.obj)) (hunit K)) ≫
            (sfQcqsCompactSupportRealization l E D.k hl c).hom.app
              ((basicSupportInput l E o c).obj K)) ∧
        (∀ (K : (basicSupportDomain l E o c).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ),
          (coefficientConstantTowerEvaluation l E Y n).map (tower.hom.app K) ≫
            (e n).hom.app K.obj =
          (coefficientRestrictedEvaluationIso l E Y n).hom.app
              ((Operations.push l E o c.g).obj
                ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K.obj))) ≫
            (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map
              ((supportEvaluation l E o c n).hom.app ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K.obj) ≫
                (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
                  (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).map
                  (((calculus l E X).reductionEvaluation n).hom.app K.obj))) ∧
        (∀ (K : (basicSupportDomain l E o c).FullSubcategory) (n : ℕ),
          (scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E Y n).map (d.hom.app K) ≫
            (sfCompactSupportFiniteReductionIso l D.k hl c E
              ((basicSupportInput l E o c).obj K) n).hom =
          ((derivedScalarExtensionRestrictionAdjunction l E Y n).choose.homEquiv _ _).symm
            ((coefficientSequenceProjection l E Y n).app
                ((Operations.push l E o c.g).obj
                  ((Operations.shriek l E o c.i).obj ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K.obj))) ≫
              (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E Y n).map
                ((supportEvaluation l E o c n).hom.app ((calculus l E X).reduction.obj K.obj) ≫
                  (sfAmbientCompactSupportCandidate
                    (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) c).map
                    (((calculus l E X).reductionEvaluation n).hom.app K.obj))))
